BrochureContent.Content:
Presented to the market in superb condition, this impressive four-bedroom detached bungalow offers a rare opportunity to acquire a spacious family home in an exceptional countryside setting, just off the Duncannon Line. Deceptively spacious and filled with natural light, this attractive residence has been thoughtfully designed to provide comfortable family living and excellent entertaining space. The well-proportioned accommodation includes four generous bedrooms, with the master bedroom benefiting from an en-suite, alongside a welcoming living room, dining room, and a large kitchen at the heart of the home. Bright and airy throughout, the property enjoys a wonderful sense of space and warmth. Set on approximately 1.33 acres, the grounds provide an ideal outdoor environment for family life. The west-facing rear aspect is perfect for enjoying evening sunshine, outdoor dining, and summer barbecues. The property also benefits from ample parking and a substantial detached garage, offering excellent storage, workshop space, or potential for a variety of other uses.
The location is equally appealing. Situated within easy reach of Wellingtonbridge (6km) and Kilmore (16km), a wide range of everyday amenities are close at hand, including schools, shops, pubs, pharmacy, church, and public transport links. Wexford Town is just 16km away, providing an extensive selection of retail, leisure, and commercial services. For those who appreciate coastal living, some of South Wexford’s most renowned beaches, including Ballyhealy, Seaview, Kilmore Quay, and Cullenstown, are all within easy reach. The picturesque fishing village of Kilmore Quay, with its award-winning marina, restaurants, and coastal attractions, is less than a 15-minute drive away. Properties of this calibre, combining generous accommodation, substantial grounds, and an outstanding location, are seldom available.

Early viewing is highly recommended.
